WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM patient_avgs
),
first_kept AS (
  SELECT pa.ID, pa.avg_ratio, oa.overall_avg
  FROM patient_avgs pa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE pa.avg_ratio > oa.overall_avg
),
second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS second_avg
  FROM first_kept
),
final_kept AS (
  SELECT fk.ID, fk.avg_ratio, fk.overall_avg, sa.second_avg
  FROM first_kept fk, second_avg sa
  WHERE fk.avg_ratio > sa.second_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  AVG(avg_ratio - overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall,
  AVG(avg_ratio - second_avg) AS avg_above_second
FROM final_kept
